deficiencies.description: The rewrite resolves the lecturer's deictic pointing words ('the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus') into a spatial relationship ('The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus') that the text does not state or show to be correct.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

considerations.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The lecturer's use of 'circumspect' is an obvious speech error for 'circumscribed' when describing a well-demarcated benign tumour; substituting the scientifically correct term is an allowed change.

considerations.sourcePassage: So contrast this fibroid that you're seeing here, this leiomyoma, with a malignant case.
considerations.reason: The text explicitly equates the fibroid with leiomyoma, so referring to it as 'This fibroid, a leiomyoma' is faithful.

considerations.sourcePassage: Movable, and literally, you can scoop it out with no damage to the surrounding tissue. All right? So a benign tumor.
considerations.reason: Dropping conversational markers ('All right? So a benign tumor') is an allowed omission of lecture filler.
